query: What documents do I need to open a store on Rakuten Ichiba?
expected_answer: To open a store on Rakuten Ichiba, you need a business registration certificate (for companies), bank account information, and identity verification documents. After passing the review process, your store will be activated.

query: Until when can I cancel an order?
expected_answer: Orders can be cancelled before shipment. After the item has been shipped, the process changes to a return rather than a cancellation. You can process cancellations through Order Management in your RMS dashboard.

query: What is the payout schedule for sales revenue?
expected_answer: Rakuten Ichiba typically pays out twice a month: once for sales from the 1st–15th (paid at month end) and once for sales from 16th–end of month (paid on the 15th of the following month). Exact schedules may vary by contract.

query: How do I authenticate with the RMS API?
expected_answer: RMS API authentication uses Basic Auth with your Service Secret and License Key encoded in Base64. Include the Authorization header in every API request: Authorization: Basic <base64(serviceSecret:licenseKey)>.

query: What items are prohibited from being listed on Rakuten Ichiba?
expected_answer: Prohibited items include weapons, controlled substances, counterfeit goods, adult-only products (without proper age-verification setup), and items that violate Japanese law. Refer to the Prohibited Items Policy document for the complete list.
